system.description: Prerequisites: Animalism (3), Protean (6). Spend three Blood Traits and win a Physical Challenge to merge with an animal host at least as large as the vampire's smallest beast form. One Mental Trait gives the animal general directions, two gives specific commands; the vampire must set a release condition in advance. The vampire takes no damage suffered by the host except fire damage (soakable with Fortitude); if the host is killed by violence, the vampire is immediately expelled.
